data.content_ref: inline:The refutation condition does not test the compatibility claim; it tests a separate sufficiency claim. Compatibility asserts that DAG topology and architectural diversity are non-exclusive mechanisms. The refutation asks whether DAG topology in a decentralized network is SUFFICIENT to overcome economic monoculture—this is a claim about one mechanism displacing another, not about their mutual compatibility in a centralized service. A compatible-with relation is refuted by showing the two mechanisms are mutually exclusive in the same system, not by showing one is independently sufficient in a different system.
